description.message: Use the local GeminiForge server to work with files, run commands, and control your computer from Gemini.

modeNote.message: This setting controls the extension’s JSON tools. Gemini handles MCP approvals separately.

autoPrompt.message: Add tool instructions to new chats

autoHint.message: Prepend tool instructions to the first message in a new chat

alwaysHint.message: Allow this tool for the rest of this chat

updated.message: The extension was updated. Refresh this page.

noEditor.message: Gemini’s message field was not found.

consent.message: Accept the upload consent dialog in Gemini.

missingImage.message: The image did not appear in the message field.

cancelSend.message: Send canceled because the input mode or chat changed.

sendTimeout.message: Send is unavailable. The image may still be uploading.

denied.message: The user declined this tool. Try another approach or ask the user.

returned.message: Round {n} results sent. Waiting for Gemini…

lastShot.message: Attached the last screenshot taken after {tool}.

next.message: Continue based on these results. When finished, summarize in plain text without further tool blocks.

busy.message: A tool is running. Stop it first.

hasPrompt.message: Tool instructions are already in the message field.

inserted.message: Instructions inserted. Enter your request and send it.

accessRequest.message: {client} is requesting access to this computer to read and write files, run commands, and control the mouse and keyboard.

pairCode.message: Enter the pairing code shown in the GeminiForge server window.

tooMany.message: Too many attempts. Try again in 10 minutes.

srvPortInUse.message: Error: port {port} is already in use by another program. Set the GF_PORT environment variable to use another port (also change it in the extension's manifest.json and background.js).

srvStop.message: Emergency stop: fling the mouse into any screen corner. Close this window to stop the server.

mcpTitle.message: GeminiForge MCP server (for Gemini's @ custom app)

mcpStop.message: Emergency stop for mouse actions: fling the mouse into a screen corner. Close this window to stop.

mcpWrongCode.message: Someone entered a wrong pairing code

bkTooLarge.message: (file is over {mb} MB; content not backed up)

bkWasMissing.message: did not exist (restore = delete the file)

bkNotFound.message: Backup {id} not found; look up ids with list_backups.

bkNoContent.message: Backup {id} has no content (the file was too large) and cannot be restored.

bkRestored.message: Restored {path} to its content from before {time}

bkDeleted.message: {path} did not exist before, so it was deleted (its content is backed up)

bkNothing.message: {path} did not exist then and does not exist now; nothing to restore
